subject: Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension (VARC)
purpose: Per-topic target quotas for building a question BANK/dataset, not a simulation of a single session's paper. Multiply/scale as needed. Mirrors the structure used for the NEET/JEE quota files so banks can be planned/compared side by side.
question_type_note: CAT VARC mixes single-correct MCQ (typically 4-5 options) and TITA (type-in-the-answer, no options). RC is almost entirely MCQ; Verbal Ability sub-types (para jumbles, para summary, odd sentence out, para completion/insertion) are a mix of both formats and vary by year - a bank should stock both formats for each VA topic.
difficulty_note: CAT has no 'easy' tier in the JEE-Main sense - even 'easy' CAT questions require careful reading under time pressure. Difficulty here reflects relative ease within the CAT distribution, skewed toward medium/hard versus a school-level exam.
